skills.purpose: Generate an interactive HTML map of a codebase (node graph, search, cited files). Use to explore or document a codebase.
Turn an MCP stdio server into a shell CLI plus a small SKILL.md to save context. Use for rarely used stateless servers.
Turn a file, text or topic into a Markmap mindmap .md. Use on /mindmap or for a quick visual outline.
Record why a fork's skill differs from upstream. Use when changing a forked SKILL.md so a later sync can re-apply it.
Turn a forked repo into a capability card. Use on /rea-harvest, mining a fork for algorithms or prompts, wrapping a CLI.
Adversarial multi-reviewer check of a contested claim or fork-strip decision; only verified quotes move the verdict.
Merge a new upstream release into a customized fork and re-apply local intent. Use after upstream tags a release.
